name: rune-tablet
author: Lil Art
description: kRO's Rune Tablet window: register runes in the Rune Book, build their sets on the Tablet and upgrade them to +15, and break items down into rune materials, all in the official Rune Tablet interface. Talk to the Rune Tablet in Prontera (193, 189). Uses the server's own Rune Tablet (Ragnarok Offline 1.6.6+), so your registered runes and sets carry over.
